notes.title: Leaderboards Are Here – 240 Ways to Compete! 🏆🚀
notes.notes:
[p]Attention Void Resurgence pilots – the competition just got serious!
We’ve officially added [b]Leaderboards[/b] to the game, and they’re not your standard “one score fits all” type.[/p][p]Instead, [i]every[/i] 30-second slice of gameplay now has its own separate leaderboard.
That means:[/p][list][*][p][b]240 unique leaderboards[/b] in total over a full 30-minute run.[/p][/*][*][p]Every half-minute is its own competition, so you can chase glory in the early game, mid game, or even the final frantic seconds.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Why This Is Awesome[/h3][list][*][p][b]More Chances to Shine:[/b] Maybe you’re not the best at going the distance, but you crush the first 5 minutes? There’s a leaderboard for that.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hyper-Specific Goals:[/b] Target your favorite time window, optimize for it, and dominate the rankings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Constant Action:[/b] No more waiting for the “perfect run” – you can always compete in a fresh leaderboard and climb your way up.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]The leaderboards update automatically, so as you play, your score in each 30-second period is recorded and compared against other pilots worldwide. You might be #1 in the 14:00–13:30 window while battling hard to break into the top 10 in the final minute.[/p][p]So… are you ready to see your name at the top?
Fire up [i]Void Resurgence[/i] and start climbing! 🛸✨[/p][p]– [i]The Void Resurgence Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Take Full Control of Your HUD with Customizable UI Transparency!
notes.notes:
[p]👀 [b]See Only What You Want[/b][/p][p]We’ve just added a brand-new [b]UI Transparency[/b] feature to Void Resurgence—so you can tweak (or hide!) every on-screen element to your heart’s content. Whether you love a crystal-clear HUD or crave a totally unobstructed view of the void, the choice is yours.

🔧 [b]How It Works[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Per-Element Sliders:[/b] In Settings → Gameplay, you’ll find a transparency slider next to each UI element (Score, Health Bar, XP Bar, Combo Text, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Total Immersion Mode:[/b] Drag all sliders to 0% to play without any HUD. No clutter, no distractions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Always Within Reach:[/b] Even if you go full minimalist, your UI magically reappears in the [b]Pause Menu[/b]—so you can check the UI at any time.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620944/00558f671aa30b4b1ec4c732b28123405aefc327.png"][/img]

🎮 [b]Why You’ll Love It[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Personalized Experience:[/b] Dial up the opacity on the elements you need and fade out the rest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cinematic Runs:[/b] Want to capture clean footage or screenshots? Hide the HUD completely for that flawless, immersive look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]On-Demand HUD:[/b] Never worry about losing track—just pause the game to bring back your UI.[/p][/*][/list][p]Head to your settings now and craft your perfect playthrough. See you out there in the void!
[/p][p]– [i]The Void Resurgence Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Void Resurgence Update: Introducing Void Vagabond!
notes.notes:
[p]🚀 [b]Attention Void Resurgence Pilots![/b][/p][p]We’ve added a brand-new, ultra-rare cosmic wanderer to the fray: the [b]Void Vagabond[/b]. Not quite a friend… not quite a foe… it’s the fastest object in the void, and catching it is a challenge worthy of legend!

👀 [b]What Is the Void Vagabond?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Speed Demon:[/b] Zips around at breakneck pace—good luck keeping up![/p][/*][*][p][b]Elusive Appearance:[/b] It only shows up [b]three times[/b] over a standard 30-minute run.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]⏱ When It Appears[/b][/p][p]The Void Vagabond will spawn [b]randomly[/b] once within each of these time windows:[/p][list][*][p][b]25:00 → 17:30[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][*][p][b]17:30 → 10:00[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][*][p][b]10:00 → 2:30[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎁 Why You’ll Want to Catch It[/b][/p][p]Bring it down and you’ll be handsomely rewarded. You might snag Core Systems level-ups and, in rare cases, even Crew members for crucial upgrades. It’s risk vs. reward at its finest—are you up for the hunt?[/p][p]
Gear up, keep your thrusters hot, and keep your eyes peeled. The Void Vagabond waits for no one… except the boldest pilots. Good luck out there!
[/p][p]– [i]The Void Resurgence Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Void Resurgence Update: Introducing Layered Health Bars!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Void Resurgence fans – we’ve got a cool new visual upgrade to share! As you blast through the game, you’ll now see your health bar come alive with [b]colorful layers[/b] instead of a single flat bar. Think of the big fighting games like Street Fighter or Tekken with multi-colored life bars – that’s exactly what inspired us. Now, when you buff your health with upgrades, your bar splits into segments (red, purple, orange, gold). As you take damage and one segment runs out, the next colored layer pops in, giving a fun, arcade-style vibe to taking a hit. This doesn’t change the game balance – it’s purely a snazzy visual touch that makes your damage feedback feel more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620944/eca024c7b1313d9f2560a574390e7cc4299c00b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll love this new look! It’s a subtle touch, but it makes it way easier to track your health in the heat of battle — and it looks awesome too! It’s like adding a little retro fighting-game flare to Void Resurgence. Give it a try in this new version and let us know what you think![/p]
